QUOTE: Python never links against the engine. It loads `librentropic.so` at runtime with `ctypes` and calls the C ABI directly. No C++ types cross the boundary.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that ctypes loads librentropic.so at runtime, with no linking against the engine. It doesn't use the words "no compiled extension module", but "never links against the engine" and `ctypes.CDLL` over a C ABI carry that substance.
